categories.evidence: Modifies CI scripts (ci/test/wrap-fd-limit.sh, ci/test/03_test_script.sh, ci/test/00_setup_env_mac_native.sh) to enforce file descriptor limits in macOS CI.
categories.rationale: Prevents recurring FD budget regressions on NetBSD by mimicking its limits in standard per-PR macOS CI runs. The description notes this addresses a recurring pattern of regressions previously caught only post-merge in nightly NetBSD runs.

categories.rationale: Fixes fatal test framework failures in `interface_ipc*.py` on NetBSD caused by exceeding the platform's FD limit.
